comp['dn'] = comp.ni20 - comp.ni19
comp['dp'] = comp.pr20 - comp.pr19
print('common families:', len(common))
print('num_instances changed count:', (comp.dn!=0).sum())
print('price changed count:', (comp.dp!=0).sum())
print(comp[comp.dn!=0].head())
print(comp[comp.dp!=0].head())
